original_unique_solution: The shown fold is the fixed vertical hinge OT. A lies on the moving top edge at perpendicular distance3 from that hinge; B is its outer endpoint at perpendicular distance6, from the card width. Opening from closed to45deg rotates each through pi/4. Their actual paths are circular arcs, so the difference is(6-3)*pi/4=3pi/4 inches. Height8 measures distance along the hinge, which does not affect the radial distance to that axis. No additional start position, center or trajectory is introduced.
